chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:
I heard Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام say: “Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام would wipe himself after defecation with cotton, and he would not wash.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam narrating this report
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose practice is being reported
key_terms.الْغَائِطِ: excrement; here, the state or place of defecation
key_terms.يَتَمَسَّحُ: he would wipe or cleanse by wiping

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about using cotton to cleanse after defecation?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding purification after relieving oneself. It is used in discussions of ritual purity and the rulings of cleansing the place of excretion.
